ClinicalDocument.title: SYNTHETIC RECORD, NOT A REAL MEDICAL RECORD — Progress Note 7 — Focused Visit (Care-plan review) — Sigmund Freud — True-date frame: synthetic events are moved into the patient's historical lifetime. Codes, instruments, and treatments remain modern and are anachronistic.

code.originalText: Five-month review: abstinence, lung and aortic screening results, pain, weight and the survivorship plan

text.paragraph: Five-month review: abstinence, screening results, pain and weight. [S]

Mr. Freud returns about five months after intake and four weeks after his wellness visit. He has not smoked for fourteen weeks. He takes varenicline 1 mg twice daily and two or three lozenges a day, and the patch was stopped at the wellness visit as planned. He has no muscle aches on atorvastatin 20 mg. The Candida stomatitis has not returned since he began cleaning the obturator nightly and leaving it out at night. His low-dose CT of the chest two weeks ago showed a 4 mm nodule (Lung-RADS 2), mild emphysema and coronary artery calcification; the aortic ultrasound was normal. He has no cough or breathlessness. His pain is 2 of 10, and he has stopped the nutrition supplements because he eats well. [S]
